We need to build complete retrosynthesis route JSON. We have target molecule? From earlier: The apply_template answer gave precursors list: [['COc1ccc(C(=O)c2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1', '[Li]C[Si](C)(C)C']]. So target molecule is product of template 1679747 applied to those precursors. The mapped_rxn shows product SMILES: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1... ) etc. That's a vinyl aryl? But we need route: root molecule with smiles of product (maybe deprotected?). The product SMILES likely is something like "C= C( ... )". But we can just use the product SMILES from mapped_rxn? The mapped_rxn product side after ">>" is product SMILES with atom maps. Remove maps: "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([O:7][CH3:8])[cH:9][cH:10]1)[c:11]1[cH:12][cH:13][c:14]([O:15][CH3:16])[cH:17][cH:18]1". Convert to SMILES without maps: "C=C(c1ccc(OC)cc1)c1ccc(OC)cc1"? Actually the aromatic rings with OCH3 substituents. So product is diphenyl ethene with methoxy groups. So target SMILES: "COc1ccc(C=Cc2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1"? Wait double bond attached to aromatic carbon. The product likely is "COc1ccc(C=Cc2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1". That matches typical stilbene with methoxy groups. So route: root molecule type mol with that smiles. Children: one reaction node with template_id 1679747, children are two mol nodes: precursor1 "COc1ccc(C(=O)c2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1" and precursor2 "[Li]C[Si](C)(C)C". That is the route.

We should verify step using verify_step maybe, but not required. Could also check buyability but not needed.
